newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 9.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.48 (-0.48)

The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd has ruled out seeking government aid to assist its ailing steel division, BHP's incoming chairman, Jerry Ellis, said on Sunday. Also the De Beers-controlled Central Selling Organization (CSO) is holding senior level talks with Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd about marketing BHP's Lac de Gras mine in Canada, the executive director of De Beers, and the CSO, Tim Capon, said on Sunday.

A Norwegian newspaper said on Saturday that Kvaerner Oil & Gas, a part of Norway's Kvaerner ASA group, has been awarded a 2.7 billion crown contract to build a floating production ship for Woodside Petroleum's Laminaria Field off Australia.

News Corp Ltd President and Chief Operating Officer Peter Chernin said on Friday he expects the company's joint venture with Tetsuya Komuro, Japan's top record producer, to be profitable within the first year or two. The new venture, to be called TK News, will initially develop and promote Asian artists in Taiwan, Hong Kong and China, and will then be expanded to other parts of Asia, the U.S. and Europe.
National Australia Bank Ltd said on Friday it would increase its benchmark (prime) lending rate to 9.90 percent from 9.85 percent effective Monday.
